environment: Disposable local MongoDB replica set; synthetic accounts only

checks.name: Real password sign-in for customer, worker, admin and canonical owner
Customer booking uses saved pricing and enforces customer/staff isolation
Assigned worker sees the booking; overlapping assignment and admin creation are blocked
Reschedule preserves the old time until admin approval and notifies the correct customer/team
Only the assigned worker completes work; unpaid completed work contributes zero revenue
Cash confirmation updates receipt, earnings and revenue exactly once; notification reads persist
Payment reversal removes revenue and invalidates receipts; timeline records actors and chat persists
Audit fixes: block/unblock restores worker role, bulk delete works, verified email cannot be bypassed and password changes revoke sessions
Worker working hours are enforced during new admin assignments
Audit fixes: review emails are private; past dates, lifecycle bypass and inaccessible admin-to-worker messages are rejected
Audit fixes: zero/clear service edits work; historical price/name snapshots survive edits and receipts download as real PDFs
Cancellation requires admin approval; support tickets isolate customers and support administrator replies/status
Owner email change requires password plus a single-use code, preserves ownership and revokes old sessions (email transport intercepted)
Only canonical owner downloads encrypted backup containing actual test database records
Wrong passphrase is rejected; dry-run validation writes no records
Transactional restore matches every exported record; BSON IDs/dates, password hashes, timelines and image URLs survive
Restore refuses a nonempty target and does not overwrite existing records
Restored accounts sign in with original credentials; owner authority, receipt, revenue, jobs and chat work
Archived login tokens are revoked after restore; owner-only operations remain protected

notes: Real HTTP routes, authentication, Mongoose queries and MongoDB transactions were used; no model mocks.
No live account, hosted API, production database or real email was used. The email-change transport alone was intercepted for OTP verification.
Cloudinary URL preservation was verified; external image delivery was not contacted.
Browser UI checks are separate from this API/database drill.
Temporary MongoDB files and encrypted test archive are removed after shutdown.
